purpose: Local proof gallery only. These manifests neither upload nor approve anything.

instructions: Keep schema_version 1. Fill sets[set_key].images with the actual current captures; leave unfinished slots absent.
Each image uses a unique order 1 through 5, matched to copy/screenshot-captions.json. iPhone 6.3 and 6.9 use iphone captions, ipad13 uses ipad, duo uses iphone_duo, and mac uses mac.

file is a relative path from index.html inside screenshots/<set_key>/, with a PNG, JPEG or WebP extension. Use plain filenames without percent escapes. No absolute paths, remote URLs, SVGs or query strings.
Use in_preparation until ready for Chris to inspect, ready_for_proof when complete, and proof_accepted only after explicit proof acceptance. None means uploaded, submitted or released.

Add optional width, height, sha256, source_revision, app_version, app_build and capture_surface for evidence. Use only non-private capture metadata. The gallery does not verify hashes or infer source identity from an image.
A missing, duplicate, invalid or unavailable image remains In preparation. Captions come from the existing copy file; do not imply its title/subtitle are already baked into the image.

instructions: Optional: leave absent until actual build evidence is ready. Missing or unknown status renders In preparation.
Use schema_version 1 and platforms.ios / platforms.mac. status must be in_preparation, ready_for_proof or proof_accepted.
The status is for this proof, not App Store availability. Supply a concise factual summary separating build, Apple processing and physical acceptance.

Record exact version/build/revision and local evidence as appropriate; do not infer production acceptance from a separate Dev/Beta build. Extra evidence fields are visible in the collapsed manifest detail.
Use proof_accepted only after acceptance of this exact intended build. Public release remains manual. No automatic upload, submission or release is performed by this gallery.

preview: Serve this folder within a loopback-only local web preview. file:// browsers can block JSON loading; the gallery reports that limitation. Do not deploy. No external fonts, scripts, libraries or media are used.
